title: The Endless Choir
author: O. M. Okafor
blurb: Edmund Almeida, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
